_comment: Pisces's INN register. Attached ONLY to pisces_inn_guest; his street hub (pisces_magic) never rides along, so the magic tutoring, the necromancy defence and EVERY door consult stay home-only -- reinforced now that door_mounting.json exists on this same map: the guest row must never touch door mechanics. A magic question is DEFLECTED in the greet, never answered. Serve mirrors selys_inn/patron_serving: {once_per_waking, item} sanctioned compound, banks the shared served_customer counter. Voice per docs/design/character-profiles.md: haughty THAWING.

greet.speaker: Pisces
greet.text: You are the one with the trays. I am not here for the cuisine, you understand, nor to discuss my work over it. The fire is adequate. My rooms have a window that will not entirely close, which I have raised with the innkeeper and expect to raise again.

text_variants._comment: #349 residence arms. `text_variants` takes `requires` only (no hide_when) and LAST MATCH WINS, so windows are carved by ORDERING. Row 1 = seal_kept_reported -> horns_dig_started, the only stretch inn.json's original Horns rows hold that corner.
text_variants.text: My team have annexed the corner by the fire and appear to consider the matter settled. I am here to observe the decline at close range. The fire is behaving. My rooms have a draft that comes in under the door, and I have moved the bed once already.

text_variants._comment: ROW 2, DIG WINDOW: between horns_dig_started and door_mounted no Horn is on the inn map, so row 1 alone described an empty corner.
text_variants.text: The corner by the fire is empty and I am told I should feel some way about that. My team are off being strenuous somewhere unlit. I have declined to be strenuous with them, and the fire is still adequate.

text_variants._comment: ROW 3: door_mounted re-arms the twins on the same cells; the corner is occupied again.
text_variants.text: My team have reclaimed the corner by the fire and appear to consider the matter settled. I have taken the next table to observe the decline at close range. The fire is generous tonight. The rooms upstairs stay cold past midnight, and I have said so at the bar.

options.text: Bring him a bowl from the kitchen. (Serve)

offduty.speaker: Pisces
offduty.text: Tavern fare is a solved problem. Salt and fat, applied in quantity until nobody thinks to ask a second question. I have eaten better in three cities. I have eaten considerably worse in nine. This kitchen I am still placing. I will want more bowls before I commit to a number.

options.text: Bring him a bowl from the kitchen. (Serve)

served.speaker: Pisces
served.text: Hm. It is competent. I have called far worse things competent, and to far worse cooks. Though I observe that I have finished it, and I observe you observing.
